tasks.label: prepare-web-next-cache
args: set -euo pipefail; web_dir="${workspaceFolder}/web"; next_dir="${web_dir}/.next"; if [ ! -d "$next_dir" ]; then exit 0; fi; if find "$next_dir" -not -user "$(id -un)" -print -quit | grep -q .; then echo "Detected non-user-owned .next cache. Removing via docker."; docker run --rm -v "$web_dir:/app" alpine:3.21 sh -c 'rm -rf /app/.next'; else rm -rf "$next_dir"; fi
